notes.title: EA Update 10: The Endless Summer Update!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]The wait is over, [b]Endless Mode[/b] is finally here! This update brings a [b]ton of new content[/b] to the game, so let’s jump straight into it:[/p][p][/p][h2]♾️ [b]Endless Mode: new rewards, new dice, new curses![/b][/h2][p]This new mode is accessible from the title screen [i](you’ll need to complete a few runs first to unlock it!)[/i]. Once you start, your goal is simple: [b]reach the highest floor possible![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Endless Mode[/b] is split into [b]loops[/b]. Every time you reach the final area, you’ll return to Area 1, but [b]enemies will get[/b] considerably [b]stronger[/b]! That’s not all: a set of [b]Endless-exclusive curses[/b] will make even the strongest builds vulnerable. Pick your poison wisely, and keep an eye out for special events where curses can be removed![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/e930ba83cff5843ee81f99ef83c5abcbe8ca1242.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🎲 A Powerful Ally: Multitype Dice![/b][/h2][p]But not all is bad news for our amphibian heroes, a new type of die awaits once you push far enough into Endless Mode: [b]multitype dice[/b]! These dice feature [b]two types[/b] at the same time, letting you [b]trigger [i]two[/i] abilities with a single use[/b]. Of course, you can still boost them, mirror them, upgrade them, basically everything you can do with regular dice. But now you’ll get double the power in one roll![/p][p][/p][p]Multitype dice come in several varieties, so we’ll let you discover them for yourself. [b]If you find one that feels especially rare, share it with us in the comments![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/75fc8b64789d6cc6282b08c881c060df735e8598.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🛡️ Meet the Elite: Beetball, the Walking Fortress![/b][/h2][p]A new elite enemy has rolled into the dungeon: [b]Beetball[/b]! Alongside Red Hood, this is part of the first wave of elites that will appear in both regular and Endless runs.[/p][p][/p][p]Like regular Bigtles, [b]Beetball’s abilities revolve around block values[/b]... but with a twist. If you ever stack [i]more[/i] block than him, he can power up even further! [b]Be cautious with your Block Dice, or you might trigger a punishing counterattack.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/e97c612a71539932d348be4a78ab39c013ff0170.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🗒️ Full Changelog for Build 113.0f1 (4.3.0)[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added[/b] new game mode: [b]Endless notes.title: Preview of EA Update 10 (Endless!) & Price Increase
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 🐸[/p][p][/p][p]The next big update is just around the corner, and we wanted to take a moment to show off all the new stuff that's coming your way![/p][p][/p][h3]But first of all, we have an important announcement to make: [b]on August 21st, Die in the Dungeon price will be updated, from $12.99 to $14.99[/b].[/h3][p][/p][p]As we mentioned in the Early Access section of the game page, [b]we believe[/b] [b]the price should reflect the amount of content and replayability the game offers in its current state[/b]. That's why we're making this change now.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, we want to [b]make sure everyone has a chance to pick up the game at a lower price[/b], which is why we’ve applied a [b]25% discount that will be active until August 21st[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026820/Die_in_the_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We're [b]planning to keep adding updates and new content all the way until the 1.0 launch[/b] next year, so big thanks to everyone who's supported the game so far![/p][p][/p][p]And talking about updates...[/p][p][/p][h1]Endless Summer Update is coming this Sunday, August 10!![/h1][p]
That's right, we've already shipped [b]9 content updates since [/b]February 21st [b](launch day)[/b], and this weekend brings another huge one! But first, let's take a quick look back at the content added since release:[/p][p][/p][h3]🤔 What’s been added so far?[/h3][p]- [b]Updates 1, 2 and 3[/b] were focused on improving stability, implementing UI enhancements (like a better view of dice in your deck) and adjusting the difficulty balance of D1. Two new difficulty levels were implemented: D5 and D6. Finally, various optimizations improved the game performance.[/p][p]- [b]Updates 4, 5 and 6[/b] introduced multiple new relics and curses, while also improving the loading times between tiles and squashing a big numbers of bugs and other issues.[/p][p]- [b]Update 7[/b] was focused on a new feature: potions! 35 new potions were added to the game, including 10 super potions for bosses. [/p][p]- [b]Update 8[/b] featured two new relics, one new potion (the winner of the create-a-potion event) and the ultimate challenge for adventurous frogs: D7 difficulty![/p][p]- [b]Update 9[/b] was published last month, and it was all about relics. More than 25 relics were reworked, also including redesigned art and big, beautiful backgrounds and animations for Area 2 and 3.[/p][p][/p][h3]♾️ Update 10 preview: Endless Mode is here![/h3][p]Endless Mode will introduce [b]brand new rewards[/b], [b]elite enemies[/b], [b]dangerous curses[/b] and even some [b]exclusive, powerful new dice[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]Remember, there's no map on endless mode, so your only [b]goal will be to reach the highest floor[/b] while tackling ever-evolving challenges. A fun new mode reminiscent of CLASSIC and Origins gameplay, but with all the new features of the main game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/75fc8b64789d6cc6282b08c881c060df735e8598.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🏹 Update 10 preview: meet the Red Hood, an elite threat![/h3][p]Endless Mode introduces a new kind of threat: [b]elite enemies[/b]. These tougher foes have [b]unique behaviors and reactive modifiers[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Red Hood[/b] is part of this first batch of enemies. She's the [b]Shyder's older[/b] (and much meaner) [b]sister[/b]. If you walk into an elite battle and see two Shyders waiting... she might not be far behind. Especially [b]dangerous when Tangled slots are in play![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/945d20540d9914a8177ac43029c4ec4d3841208c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]📅 What's coming next? [/h3][p]With Endless mode almost here, you might be wondering what other features might be coming for Die in the Dungeon, right? Well, we managed to get our hands on some [strike]unsupervised[/strike] [i]Dungeon Blueprints[/i], and it seems like there's many yet-to-be-explored places awaiting our amphibian heroes![/p][p][/p][p]- 🎮 [b]Controller support.[/b] We’re ironing out the last few bugs and plan to [b]move it from beta to the main branch soon[/b] ([b]including Steam Deck[/b] improvements!).[/p][p]- ⚠️ [b]New Events.[/b] Many events are getting a full rework. Expect [b]better rewards[/b], [b]more meaningful choices[/b], and maybe even the [b]return of dice rolls[/b] (like in Origins!).[/p][p]- 📜 [b]Bestiary & Lore.[/b] The [b]missing Codex section is coming[/b]! Learn about all the dungeon's weird inhabitants, and uncover [b]more about Cinder, Lisver, Mango[/b], and the world around the dungeon.[/p][p]- 🐉 [b]More Elite Enemies.[/b] Red Hood's just the beginning. [b]New elite enemies[/b] will appear across all areas. Rumors even mention a [b]Dragonfly nest somewhere[/b] down there...[/p][p]- 🗝️ [b]Secrets![/b] What's a roguelike without a few hidden paths here and there? We don't want to spoil anything just yet, but traversing the dungeon will definitely get more interesting once you start to uncover the many [b]hidden passages and shortcuts[/b] it contains.[/p][p][/p][p]And with that, we're done with... wait, what's that? Something's moving in the shadows. Is that... [b]a frog!?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/25c4808c869ae72f0bc53ba76fcdc80300da47ff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]● ● ●[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for playing, and for all your support, we couldn’t do this without you. The Endless Summer update arrives this Sunday, we hope you love it as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing! 🐸💚[/p][p]- the ATICO team[/p]

notes.title: EA Update 9: The Big Relic Overhaul!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

We're back with a [b]huge wave of balance changes and fixes[/b], in what will be known as... 

[/p][h2]🏆The Big Relic Overhaul Update![/h2][p]
For a long time, we've wanted to make underused relics more viable, and we finally got the chance! This update [b]reworks over 25 relics[/b], making them easier to use, more fun, and generally more rewarding. We also [b]adjusted the rarity of many relics[/b], mostly downgrading them so the relic pool feels more diverse and more accessible during your runs. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/8ba754f6d70d9b72831f19a83914c26fa008b410.png"][/img][/p][p]We're always looking for ways to keep the game fresh and interesting, and the next area we see great potential is enemies and mobs. Expect redesigns, new mechanics, and a few fresh modifiers coming in the near future!
[/p][p][/p][h2]🖌️New Art for Areas, Events, and More![/h2][p]
The new background animations are here! ...well, we teased a preview in the last update, but this time [b]all events[/b] have received brand-new art and animations. We also adjusted some issues with [b]backgrounds in Areas 2 and 3[/b], and fixed certain events showing the wrong background art. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/bb94e2055d93954ecce029737338d692a08dbcdf.png"][/img][/p][p]But there's even more: [b]several menus have been revamped[/b], including boards, the finish-turn button, dice shadows, and a few special slots.[/p][p] [/p][p]Also, we squeezed in a handful of non-relic–related balance changes and bugfixes for good measure. notes.title: Q&A Time with the Frog Reporter and Summer Sale Discount!
notes.content: [h3]🎤 [b]The Frog Reporter is back with a special episode: it's Q&A time![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]In this latest video, our intrepid reporter answers community-submitted questions about [i]Die in the Dungeon[/i], covering everything from game development and design decisions to deep lore, character trivia… and even the frogs’ favorite food!? 🐸🥗  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Jetb18esZrw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Prefer reading over watching? We’ve got you covered! A full transcript will be posted at the end of this post.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]💸 Die in the Dungeon is now part of the Steam Summer Sale![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]That's right, the game is currently [b]on discount[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p]There's no better time to jump in, whether you’re just starting your dungeon-crawling journey or returning to discover all the new features we’ve added since launch.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026820/Die_in_the_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Tell your friends, your family, and your frogs: [b]the dungeon is awaiting newcomers![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🤔 Q&A Transcript[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]1. How’s the "J" in Jaun pronounced?[/b][/p][p]It doesn’t matter, because everyone calls me Juan anyway.[/p][p]Just kidding, it’s pronounced with a Spanish “J” (known as jota in Spanish). Think: jalapeño.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. What’s your favorite color?[/b][/p][p]- Jaun: Orange[/p][p]- Alarts: Black[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Will there be other pets/companions to get?[/b][/p][p]Definitely! We love the two cute critters already in the game and are excited to add a few more. We already have some ideas for new pets that will accompany our frogs on their journeys through the dungeon.[/p][p]We’re also working on one related to a very special thing happening in August, stay tuned...[/p][p][/p][p][b]4. When will we get a pet Croissantpillar?[/b][/p][p]Croissantpillars appear cute, but they’re actually incredibly hard to tame. They’re quite dangerous and usually only listen to their creator.[/p][p]That said, there are rumors of a particularly docile flavor of Croissantpillar hidden in the dungeon, even we haven’t found it yet.[/p][p][/p][p][b]5. What are the three playable characters’ favorite foods?[/b][/p][p]- Cinder: Plain bread. Though she used to love lily-pad salads…[/p][p]- Lisver: Spicy pineapple pico de gallo (served on tacos, of course).[/p][p]- Mango: Anything sweet! Chocolate chip cookies, croissants, cheesecake, crème brûlée…[/p][p][/p][p][b]6. Why was Cinder’s name changed from CLASSIC?[/b][/p][p]Actually, Cinder’s name was never revealed in CLASSIC. During development, many players wanted to know the frog’s name, so we added an easter egg:[/p][p]There’s a question in the Trivia Spider event that asks about your name, but it’s just a joke, since all answers are marked correct.[/p][p]So no, Rana (or Frogget the First) is not Cinder’s original name, but it’s a cute name nonetheless![/p][p][/p][p][b]7. When are we getting a more proper story to the game, if there is any?[/b][/p][p]There’s already a lot of lore written for Die in the Dungeon, and we plan to introduce it gradually and subtly.[/p][p]This helps us ensure each new piece fits the larger story.[/p][p]You, the player, will discover clues about what happened, and why you’re in the dungeon in the first place.[/p][p][/p][p][b]8. Is Mango based on a particular amphibian?[/b][/p][p]A frog, duh! 🙂[/p][p]But seriously, the closest real-world frog would probably be the Burmese Squat Frog.[/p][p][/p][p][b]9. What is the Potion Mimic’s favorite food?[/b][/p][p]Careless adventurers who try to drink from it without realizing it’s a mimic![/p][p][/p][p][b]10. Does Lisver have the red thingy on both sides of his face?[/b][/p][p]It’s a scar...[/p][p]No, it’s not on both sides, and he really doesn’t like to talk about it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]11. How do the devs plan all the development and changes?[/b][/p][p]We already have several features and systems in mind that we want to add, each with a timeframe listed on our roadmap.[/p][p]However, the schedule can change if something urgent comes up that needs to be addressed first.[/p][p][/p][p][b]12. If you were in the dungeon, how long do you think you’d survive?[/b][/p][p]Seeing a Flyfant in real life would probably be a very traumatic experience…[/p][p]So yeah, not long.[/p][p][/p][p]And finally, a bonus answer for the readers![/p][p][/p][p][b]13. When are we getting bigger dice?[/b][/p][p]We’ve always wanted to add bigger dice with more faces, but they require a lot of time to balance properly, especially with all the different boards, character abilities, relics, etc.[/p][p]For now, we’re focused on polishing the current game and preparing for version 1.0. After that, we’ll experiment with how bigger dice feel in play.[/p]

notes.title: EA Update 8: Summer Is Coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Summer break is nearly here, and while the ATICO team is gearing up for a bit of rest, we couldn’t leave without dropping a fresh patch first. So grab a [i]Watermelon Slice[/i] and let's dive in!

[h2]🎲 Difficulty D7 + Two New Relics[/h2]

Any veteran frogs over here? Your next challenge has arrived! [b]D7 difficulty adds a brutal twist:[/b]

- [b]Scarcer healing.[/b] Fewer opportunities to recover HP, so time to treasure those Heal Dice!

To compensate a little, you will receive a [b]brand new Legendary relic[/b] when completing this challenge: [b]Lazarus Heart[/b]! And what about the other relic? Feast your eyes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/8fdebf038b96d56a96e8aa7be70f5af151d2a9eb.png[/img]

[b]Grinding Leaf[/b] introduces a new mechanic: [b]permanent modifiers![/b] These modifiers persist between battles, letting you snowball power across an entire run. Big thanks to youtuber [i]TimeToGrind[/i] for the collaboration!

[h2]🧪 Potion Labs Winner![/h2]

Our Potion events are officially over! In the first event, players (and testers) raced to unlock the [i]Grand Brewmaster[/i] achievement... [b]filling all spots on the leaderboards in less than 24 hours![/b]

On the other hand, the potion labs were [i]brewing[/i] with ideas in the past weeks, with [b]more than 100 very original entries![/b] Among the 10 most upvoted, it was hard to pick only one to implement into the game. After much bubbling and tasting, the winner is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/ddf2acfe5dc0d07a9d2ca64fa6e9fe3fd4dd1f1f.png[/img]

The [b]Ghost Super Potion[/b] is a powerful, build-up blast that will make even big mosquitos shiver in fear!

[h2]🎮 Controller Support in [beta][/h2]

The first controller-ready build is [b]live on a beta branch[/b] for anyone who wants an early peek!

[h3]How to opt-in on the [beta] branch:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Right-click [b]Die in the Dungeon[/b] in your Steam library → [b]Properties[/b].
[*] Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab.
[*] Enter the code [i]"enterditdbeta"[/i] and select the branch.
[/olist]
A [b]new "Controller Support" category has been added to the in-game feedback panel[/b], please report anything wrong or wonky. We're aiming to gather notes and ship a polished, default-branch build later this summer.

[h2]🗒️ Full Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] full controller support with graphical input prompts.
[*] [b]Added[/b] D7 difficulty level.
[*] [b]Added[/b] new relic: [b]Lazarus Heart[/b] → [i]Every time you overheal, add the overhealed amount to the value of this relic. At the start of the turn, deal that value as damage to all enemies.[/i]
[*] [b]Added[/b] new relic [b]Colorful Leaf[/b] → [i]Add your healing to this relic's value. If 40 or more at the start of battle, gain 1 permanent positive modifier.[/i]
[*] [b]Added[/b] new potion [b]Super Ghost Potion[/b] → [i]Deal 3+(1d4) to the target enemy for each enemy killed after obtaining this potion.[/i]
[*] [b]Added[/b] "uses" indicator to relic UI.
[*] [b]Added[/b] new term tooltip: Permanent Modifier.
[*] [b]Modified[/b] relic [b]Hidden Ace[/b] → [i]On odd turns, get +1 Bonus modifier. Gain +1 energy for every 15 dice drawn.[/i]
[*] [b]Modified[/b] relic [b]Tungsten Hand[/b] → [i]Once per turn, you can unlock 1 dice on the board.[/i]
[*] [b]Modified[/b] relic [b]Promo Ticket[/b] description → [i]Next forge will include two free relics. This relic will be discarded after use.[/i]
[*] [b]Modified[/b] potion reward logic to avoid offering two potions from the same family (e.g. Minor + Major Health).
[*] [b]Modified[/b] healing: raising max HP no longer restores you to full HP.
[*] [b]Modified[/b] RNG to increase item variety (dice, relic and potions).
[*] [b]Modified[/b] potions price in the shop (now reduced to base 3/7/11).
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] loading screen visible in the background on certain resolutions.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] poison icon graphic.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] [b]Septic Bandage[/b] relic incorrectly triggering certain relics (that should only trigger when player heals).
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] softlock after a successful roll when using Jester Potion with no dice in hand.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] interaction between Terrain and all Mirror dice variants.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] certain Flash+Toxic dice not applying poison.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] [b]Super Jester Potion[/b] description ("[i]temporarily[/i]" → "[i]permanently[/i]").
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] incorrect CJKR font on potion-specific dice.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] [b]Verdant Potion[/b] interaction with Brewmaster modifier.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] map RNG issue that changed some tile types after loading a save.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] bug where directional keys bypassed restrictions in the "modify dice faces" menu.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] enemy modifiers overlapping the board in certain fights (e.g. during Caterpillar Baker and Queen Bee boss fights).
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] endless loading screen when exiting a run while a tile was still loading.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] new runs incorrectly inheriting rewards from the previous run if you quit during tile loading.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] softlock on Obtain Curse reward when player already has all curses.
[/list]

[h2]🔮 What’s Next and a Merch Poll![/h2]

That’s all for today, but plenty is simmering for the summer: [b]new enemies, brand-new mechanics, the long-awaited Endless Mode[/b], and more! We want to iterate on every feature to make sure they are just right, and we make it with the help of our amazing testers (thank you guys!). If you’d like to join that crew, hop into our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/die-in-the-dungeon-829107672912494613][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/36521057687e50d902a5885bb944c1531064d957.png[/img][/url]

But there's not only testing on our server! We also run [b]regular polls, events, and sneak-peeks there[/b]. This is our current question to the community:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/e10c025a2d23359e82bb7e78412b8bfef1cdff99.png[/img]

[b]Let us know your pick in the comments![/b]

Thank you for playing!

- the ATICO team

notes.title: EA Update 7: The Potions Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A new update just dropped, and it brings a [b]brand-new mechanic: Potions![/b] 
Let’s take a look at how they work:

[h2]🧪 Potions 101[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/e07e9726d92f10ad39088bc1a18a8cddbbfd9ce0.png[/img]

Potions are consumable items that trigger [b]immediate effects during battle[/b]. When used, they roll a set of dice and apply effects based on the result. Sometimes, you'll need to [b]reach or exceed a specific value[/b] for the effect to succeed.

Just like relics, potions come in different [b]rarities[/b], the rarer the potion, the stronger (and sometimes riskier!) the effect. A special line of high-powered potions, called [b]Super Potions[/b], can be earned [b]only after boss battles[/b]. You’ll get [b]just two per run[/b], so use them wisely!

notes.title: EA Update 3: Reworked Difficulties and New Levels: D5 and D6!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

After a hectic (and great!) launch period, we’re now [b]focusing on key design issues reported by players[/b] in reviews, forums, and feedback reports. Here’s a [b]non-exhaustive list[/b] of some of the most important ones:

[list]
[*] The difficulty jump between D0 and D1 is too steep.
[*] Runs feel too long.
[*] Dice rewards are not exciting enough.
[*] Elite Battles are repetitive (same enemies).
[*] The Resilient modifier from the Roachvil enemy is frustrating.
[*] Inconsistent UI in certain menus (like the backpack).
[/list]

We want to [b]address these issues over time[/b], and this update takes the first step toward improving several of them. Let’s go over the changes:

[h2]Difficulty Overhaul[/h2]

All difficulty levels have been reshuffled to create a smoother progression. [b]D1 has been split into two levels[/b]—one focusing on higher HP enemies, and the other introducing new actions and stronger attacks. We’ve also added a [b]brand-new difficulty level involving curses![/b]

As always, balance is tricky, so we’d love to hear your feedback on these changes. Your input helps us [b]shape a better game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/2e868713480a03812515390aad082ad89c73d5e3.png[/img]

[h2]Resilient Modifier Rework[/h2]

Many players found the [b]Resilient modifier from Roachvil frustrating[/b], as it sometimes required very specific dice rolls to land an [b]Accurate Kill[/b].

To fix this, we’ve [b]tweaked the mechanic[/b] so that failing the Accurate Kill is [b]less punishing[/b]. Now, instead of the enemy remaining nearly unkillable, it will either [b]buff or debuff you[/b], depending on whether you succeed or fail with the Accurate Kill. Roachvil is already a tough enemy with high damage output, so this should [b]balance it better without removing the core mechanic[/b].

[h2]More Exciting Dice Rewards (and Better UI!)[/h2]

Area 1 can feel a bit stale after multiple runs, so we’ve implemented a popular request: [b]loosened area-based dice restrictions![/b]

This means dice from later areas [b]can now appear earlier,[/b] making deck-building [b]more dynamic and exciting[/b]. These dice will still be [b]rarer in early areas[/b], but we hope this will allow for more creative builds and strategies!

Additionally, we’ve [b]fully implemented[/b] the UI update from our last post—dice in the[b] backpack now display all relevant information[/b], making the UI more consistent across menus. [b]If you have any UI/UX feedback, let us know![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/18396ff7ed1a679bce039f3bb1928f190180c542.png[/img]

[h2]Support for Speedrunning... and Future Challenges?[/h2]

As a bonus for this update, we’ve introduced a toggleable in-game timer!

We've noticed a growing [b]speedrunning community[/b] in our Discord, so we wanted to provide a [b]reliable timer[/b]. Since we're still working on reducing loading times, the timer has been adjusted to exclude load times from its count.

Looking ahead, we’d love to organize challenge-specific runs with the community! These won’t necessarily be speedrun-focused, but could introduce unique restrictions. Let us know if you’d be interested!

[h2]Changelog for Die in the Dungeon EA Version 4.1.7 (109.0f0):[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Added[/b] two new difficulties: D5 & D6.
[*][b]Added[/b] new UI for dice in the backpack (including description for modifiers and energy cost)
[*][b]Added[/b] toggleable in-game timer to settings.
[*][b]Added[/b] two new relics: Insect Repellent & Sticker Pack.
[*][b]Added[/b] three new curses: Septic Bandage, Idolizing Eye and Shattered Opal.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] multiple issues related to screen resolution.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Jester event always removing properties from first valid dice in deck.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] incorrect hitbox in relic rewards.
[*][b]Modified[/b] Resilient modifier behavior (from Roachvil enemy).
[*][b]Modified[/b] rules for difficulties D1, D2 and D4.
[*][b]Modified[/b] HP and attack value of multiple enemies.
[*][b]Modified[/b] shop cost scaling per area (reduced in Area 2 and 3).
[*][b]Modified[/b] graphics for difficulty icon.
[*][b]Modified[/b] dice rewards in all areas.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

For the next update, [b]our top priority is still reducing loading times[/b], especially in later stages. We have tentative fixes in progress, but they [b]require thorough testing[/b] as they impact critical game systems.

Meanwhile, [b]controller support[/b] is progressing steadily, and we’re fixing [b]various input-related issues[/b] before opening a beta branch for early testing.

Finally, a [b]small teaser[/b]: this week, we’re starting work on [b]new content![/b] We’re excited to introduce [b]a fun mechanic that makes battles a bit less RNG-dependent[/b]. More details soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/91ec6f17fb5d0145610e7837dedfc6b02163315c.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog: Early Access State, Roadmap and Supporter Pack
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, folks![/h2]
You might have already seen Die in the Dungeon popping up with some content creators! Their early feedback has helped us refine the game, smoothing out rough edges in preparation for launch.

That’s right, we’re racing full speed toward Early Access on [b]February 21[/b]! It’s hard to believe it’s finally happening, but here we are.

Now’s the perfect time to break down what you can expect at launch, what’s coming in the first few months, and a little something special for those who want to support us!

[h2]Early Access Content[/h2]
The game is content-complete based on our original vision, meaning all planned areas, characters, dice, events, relics, and unlockables are already in place. But we still have plenty of ideas on how to make the game even better!

At this stage, we believe listening to the community should be our top priority, just as we did throughout all previous versions (Classic, Origins, and the Demo).

Here’s what you’ll get at launch:

- 🗺️ [b]Three areas[/b], filled with new enemies and [b]five unique bosses[/b]!
- 🐸 [b]Three playable characters[/b], each with a unique board and exclusive dice types.
- 🪙 [b]100 relics[/b] to collect and experiment with.
- 🎲 [b]31 different dice[/b] types with [b]14 combinable properties[/b].
- 💪 [b]Four[/b] extra [b]difficulty levels[/b].
- 🏆 [b]40 achievements[/b] and unlockables.
- 💬 Full localization in [b]11 languages[/b].

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
We have big plans for Die in the Dungeon beyond launch. Here’s a look at what’s coming in the first few months:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/490aab411d718e3302c4f479a2973dbd7cfd7cbe.png[/img]

[h3]1. 🎮 Controller Support[/h3]
We originally aimed to have controller support ready for launch but decided to hold off until we could do it right. Expect a much smoother and more polished controller experience in a post-launch update.

We may even introduce it through a beta branch first, stay tuned!

[h3]2. ♾️ More Difficulties & Endless Mode[/h3]
At launch, you’ll already have four unlockable difficulty levels (with more to come in the future!), but we want even the best players to have more interesting challenges and rewards.

That’s why we’re working on [b]Endless Mode[/b], a fresh challenge with new enemies and bespoke mechanics for those who want to push their limits.

[h3]3. 👁️ Sneak Peek into the Future[/h3]
We don't want to reveal too much just yet, but here's is a small taste of what's coming:

[b]- Better Events.[/b] As a beloved mechanic from Origins, we want to reintroduce [b]dice-rolling during events[/b]. But this time, we have a much better idea on how to make them feel better and more balanced. More details soon!

[b]- Bestiary and More Content.[/b] The new Codex already includes an exhaustive list with all characters, dice and relics in the game, but something’s still missing… enemies! We’re working on a proper Bestiary with detailed enemy info, including lore! Of course, we’ll also continue expanding other categories with new dice, relics, and more.

[b]- Story and Secrets.[/b] While we focused primarily on gameplay for the Early Access release, that doesn’t mean we aren’t planning to expand the world of Die in the Dungeon. In fact, those of you who played CLASSIC will probably have a few questions waiting for an answer…

[b]Is there a *true ending* awaiting our amphibian heroes?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/7c425f65bff17ac805a0727e75f607477bee101f.png[/img]

If you’d like to [b]support the development of Die in the Dungeon, the Supporter Pack is a great way to do so[/b]! By picking it up, you’ll be directly helping us continue improving and expanding the game while receiving some exclusive content in return.

This pack is [b]purely cosmetic[/b] and does not affect gameplay, it’s simply a way for fans to show their support and contribute to the game’s ongoing development.

[h2]Steam Raffle Winner[/h2]
Before we go, it's time to announce the winner of our Steam raffle!

As we gear up for the launch of Die in the Dungeon, we're excited to share some major updates and celebrate the incredible journey we've had so far. Let's dive into the details!


[h2]A Release Date is Set! 🗓️[/h2]

Yes, you read that right, [b]Die in the Dungeon finally has a release date![/b] While we’ll officially announce it next month, let’s just say you’ll only need less than 15 frog hands to count the days left! 🐸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/717f1e3824ce0dd022a9392e4305520c27d8ef9a.png[/img]

Well, all content for Areas 1, 2 and 3 is officially finished, so we have been working on squashing bugs and polishing important stuff like localization, controller support and game balancing. The game has a significant amount of combinations between dice, relics, events, characters and more, so fixing problematic behaviors and making sure the difficulty feels good is our top priority.

That said, being close to release also means we had to make a tough call: we're [b][u]pausing work on the final demo[/u][/b] to fully [b]prioritize the release[/b]. While we know this might be disappointing, it’s a decision we made to ensure the full game is as great as it can be. 

The game has had many versions over the years, but we're still sad that we couldn't keep our promise of releasing one last demo before launch. We deeply appreciate your understanding and support, and rest assured, we’re pouring our hearts into making Die in the Dungeon a game worth waiting for.

notes.title: Die in the Devblog: Demo Feedback & Winter Release
notes.content:
Hey guys!

It's time for a new devblog! It’s been a while, and a lot has happened since we published the demo back in June!

Today, we’ll cover:
- How your [b]feedback from the demo[/b] has helped shape the game.
- [b]What we’re currently working on[/b].
- And, of course... our [b]updated release timeline[/b]!

[h2]The Demo and Your Feedback[/h2]

This summer, we launched our demo during Steam Next Fest. The demo introduced [b]new dice, enemies and relics[/b], along with a key new feature—a [b]map that lets you control your character’s path using dice[/b].

We believed this feature would add a new strategic layer, but [b]thanks to your feedback, we realized we’d missed the mark[/b]. Here’s what we learned:
- The map required too much focus and slowed down the gameplay.
- Map choices felt repetitive and lacked real impact.
- Overall, the pace from the Demo felt worse than [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428770/Die_in_the_Dungeon_Origins/]Origins[/url].

Your feedback helped us recognize that this mechanic needed a rethink. We went back to the drawing board, understanding that the previous map was too complex and detracted from [b]what we believe makes Die in the Dungeon truly shine—the dice-based battles![/b] The [b]new map is now simpler[/b], letting you to explore the dungeon more intuitively and focus on the core combat experience. [b]Huge thanks to our Discord community and players on the Steam forums[/b] for your invaluable feedback along the way!

In addition, here are some other changes inspired by your feedback:
- [b]Dice shapes are no longer limited to D4s[/b], other shapes are now available like the good ol' D6 ([spoiler]and maybe some with even more faces![/spoiler])
- [b]Dice with face values of 0 aren't part of the starting deck anymore[/b]. Builds around 0s are still possible though, if you dare go for them.
- [b]Difficulty in Area 1 has been adjusted[/b] to create a less punishing experience at the start. Difficulty will still ramp up considerably the deeper you delve into the dungeon, this is a hard game after all!

[h2]When’s the Release?[/h2]

Originally, the game was planned for a mid-fall release. However, with the changes to the game’s mechanics, we realized we needed more time to get things just right. As a result, we’ve made the tough decision to [u][b]push the release to this Winter[/b][/u] to ensure Die in the Dungeon meets our standards (and yours!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/7f0fe322aaa972cae26d07a1a505f31416b0ed5d.png[/img]

We know many of you were eagerly waiting for the original date, and we’re grateful for your patience. Ultimately, we don’t want to deliver a game that feels unpolished, which is why we’re willing to go the extra mile to make Die in the Dungeon as enjoyable as possible on release. This extra time is also allowing us to introduce a few new features, such as the Codex section you can see above!

[h2]Our Next Steps[/h2]

Currently, we know the demo on Steam doesn’t reflect the latest game improvements. To avoid any confusion, [b]we’ll be taking the current demo down the day this devlog goes live[/b]—but not for long! We’ll upload an [b]updated version of the demo very soon[/b], to let you try the game and make an informed decision before release. As always, don’t hesitate to voice your opinion when it drops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/6ece19220cb3aee6dc4d57e28a2f2d324defbfb6.png[/img]

Now, you might be wondering: so [b]what's left before release?[/b] Honestly, not much! [b]99% of the content has already been implemented,[/b] including several new dice types, properties, enemies and bosses for Area 2 and 3. On this last stretch, [b]all that's left is fixing the remaining bugs, polishing the game, and balancing all the elements[/b]. Thankfully, our team of testers is currently helping us with all that, so things are progressing at a steady pace in preparation for launch!

That's all for today! Stay tuned for the updated demo, and thank you again for your patience. We can't wait for you to experience what we've been working on.

Stay safe, and may your dice rolls be ever in your favor!

— The ATICO Team

P.S: Speaking of testers, we're currently looking for new applicants in preparation for release. Join our Discord server and head to [i]#announcements[/i] to learn more: https://discord.gg/die-in-the-dungeon-829107672912494613

notes.title: Die in the Devblog vol.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, long time no see![/h2]
We've missed you!

We've got quite a bit of news in the meantime! 
And at the same time, we'll show you what we've been working on lately and what we're preparing for the final release.

Let's start with saying [b]thank you for your support during the release of Origins![/b]
We’re happy to see that many of you are still playing it (more than [b]2000 reviews with 95% positive[/b], crazy!). We've received tons of useful feedback, which we've immediately started processing. 

But Origins is just a part of our journey. And you'll see its new chapter very soon!

But let's go step by step...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/27335412d7c4e4da3b03ec1235ef2025f05c70e1.gif[/img]

[h2]New Systems[/h2]
So, if you remember the previous versions of our game and the prologues, they were quite linear. Our cute frogs fought battle after battle, they had no time to rest, and their attempts to pass through the dungeon was a bit too similar between them.

Something that we wanted to add for a long time was a mechanic that shakes up the familiar rules of Die in the Dungeon - [b]the travel map[/b]. Now you can choose your direction of movement and the events that await you throughout the dungeon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/70c82407dd210ea54fb8938138804a5885b6f713.gif[/img]
[i](visuals are WIP)[/i]

At the same time, we wanted to find a different approach on the usual way maps work in other roguelikes. 
A signature element of our design is dice and the ability to control randomness. We were[b] inspired by traditional tabletop games[/b] and made dice the instrument used for moving along the map.

Thus, dice rolls determine your fate not only during battles but also during movement through the game world.

We are still exploring this game mechanic and working on how its design functions. You'll be able to try out this mechanic very soon!

[h2]Steam Next Fest![/h2]

And our next stop is [b]10th June[/b] at Steam Next Fest! In just 3 weeks you are going to see our new build! 

With the introduction of this new system, we would like to get feedback from you before our release. 
In addition to the map system, we have some others surprises for this version, but we don't want [strike]to reveal all our cards[/strike] roll all the dice just yet. Let's just say: from a gameplay perspective, the game has become much more diverse, so we want to make sure we're moving in the right direction. 

Here is a BIG tease of [b]some of the new dice you will see in the dem[/b]o:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/a375f70d5d44314e363b0cdd09c62a164e534f3e.gif[/img]

And yes, you will be able to check out our new map system too!

Also, as many of you know, [b]Steam Next Fest is also a great opportunity to show the game to new players, so here we count on your support[/b]. 

[h2]Future plans.[/h2]
Steam Next Fest is the final stop before the push towards the Early Access release. We don't want to make promises too early, but we plan to release the game this year and sooner than you might think. We know it's a bit vague, but think of it as a pleasant surprise if everything works out as expected!

And as always: add Die in the Dungeon to your wishlists if you haven't already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026820/Die_in_the_Dungeon/

We promise to keep you updated! Don't forget to follow us on Twitter and Discord!

notes.title: Die in the Devblog vol.1
notes.content:
Hello, friends! Today is announcement time!

Here we go: on [b]December 1st[/b], our new prologue, Die in the Dungeon: Origins, will be released!

While we are preparing for the release, making final adjustments to the balance, and finishing localization (which we'll also talk about today), let's discuss the progress we've made since the release of the last version of the game.

Sit back and relax; there's a lot of exciting new details waiting for you! 

And remember: all these gameplay elements will also appear in the full version!

[h1]So… What is Origins?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/9bed1d86ff883f0fa8cf549d567fd8bcd489267c.png[/img]

[b]Origins is a free prequel to the main game, coming to Steam in just a week![/b] The game takes place several years before the events of Die in the Dungeon, featuring many new mechanics and a new playable character, Lisver.

For this prologue, we have updated the art and introduced new features to make the game more interesting and unique, while also keeping the core dice and board mechanics from the original version.

Let's dive into the details!

[h1]Perilous Events[/h1]

Throughout your adventures, you'll encounter not only a series of new enemies and dice but also unique events. True heroes don't just fight. Now, between battles, you'll sometimes come across special events where you can make decisions that open up new dice or, on the contrary, become obstacles you'll have to deal with. And there, you can acquire new relics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/facb60244a30b7353031a11bb21ffb0c6cc3a347.gif[/img]

Whaaaaat? What are these relics? Don't worry; we'll explain now!

[h1]Precious Relics[/h1]

Relics are special items that will change the way dice work, altering the properties of your board and the rules of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/8bae8e1385f60982600a39468bc000e9d938bcc3.gif[/img]

We've added [b]more than 40 relics[/b] to help you create even more unique decks of dice. After all, their main task is to make each playthrough unique!

[h1]The Prism[/h1]

New dice coming! Prism Dice are a highly powerful type of dice... if used correctly. By themselves, they don't really do much. But when you combined them with other dice, well, they say a gif is worth more than a thousand words:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/be62eeabf04fd9c4e49f16083ecfee2cb9524220.gif[/img]

That's right, Prims Dice reflect the power of other dice like Boost and Mirror, allowing them to target more slots and increasing their power greatly. Not bad, uh?

[h1]Meet Lisver[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/dd569d7b705af89444bc3529c48471a71732e664.gif[/img]
Lisver is a semi-retired Dice Knight, a legendary hero considered by many to be the fastest warrior in the realm. His offensive-based fighting style focuses on striking first and striking hard, with its own unique battle board and a brand new dice property: Flash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/4af0318c89255a85a74d578c8f4fd478655cb745.gif[/img]

But new heroes need new enemies!

[h1]The Doctor is here![/h1]

Coming from the depths of the dungeon, a new enemy appears!

Plague bugs will use their poisonous potions to infect your board. This infection will quickly spread through slots, so use your dice to stop it before it's too late!

But believe us, this guy shouldn’t be your main concern! Someone bigger is waiting for you around the corner…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/65b29bf4404952102d4e98c2d6dbba4ebda8bdcb.png[/img]

[h1]Localization![/h1]

Finally, let's discuss the localization of our new prologue! Making the game accessible to player all around the globe has been a priority for us for a long time… 

So, we can confirm [b]localization in 11 languages: English, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, and Turkish![/b]

Currently, we are selecting fonts, testing translations, and will strive to prepare all these languages for the release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42906754/62d2cb6077748e3998448ab91b1871dac458a4b6.png[/img]

That's all for today!

Don't forget to add Die in the Dungeon to your wishlists so you get notified when it launches!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026820/Die_in_the_Dungeon/

[h2]Remember: on December 1st you will be able to try out all these... for free! Save the date!
[/h2]

Until next time!
ATICO team
